title: Shootout At Wadala
desc: A crime-action film based on a true story. The movie depicts the rise of a gangster, who becomes a force to be reckoned within Mumbai's criminal underworld. It also highlights the police's efforts to capture him and the infamous shootout that took place in Wadala- Mumbai. The film features themes of power, revenge, and justice in a gritty and violent setting.

title: Parineeta
desc: Childhood sweethearts Lalita and Shekhar wish to get married someday. However, Shekhar's growing suspicions about Lalita coupled with his conniving father's antics threaten to tear them apart.

title: Ki & Ka
desc: Kia, an ambitious woman, marries Kabir, a man who prefers the role of a house husband. They enjoy their unconventional relationship until challenges, including ego clashes and jealousy set in.

title: Chalo Dilli
desc: Mihika, an investment banker, misses her flight to Delhi and meets Manu Gupta, a talkative man. In order to reach Delhi on time, she must tag along with Manu and put up with his antics.
